Perform basic client connectivity checks, service/agent status checks and communication troubleshooting in coordination with server teams. Review previous-shift handover, outstanding incidents, scheduled jobs, planned changes and known issues at the start of each shift. Provide clear and concise shift handovers covering incidents, alerts, failures, pending activities and escalation status. Support 24x7 operations, including rotational shifts, weekends and on-call support as required by the business. Escalate critical incidents immediately and provide regular status updates until ownership is transferred or service is restored.
